_comment: The AMBIENT PAL registry — which set-dressing species exist and how their sheets are laid out (see PalView + tools/gen_pals.py, art authored in tools/pixelart). A world seed's ambient_pals entries pick a 'species' + 'variant' (a natural coat color, clamped to 'variants'); an entry without a species — or with one this registry doesn't know — falls back to the companion-puppet pal, so old seeds keep working. Sheets are res://assets/pals/<species>_<variant>.png: 8 motion columns (col 0 = idle), one row per RIGHT-handed facing in 'rows' (the left family mirrors at runtime). 'fly_row' (bird only) is the wing-flap cycle PalView switches to while the pal is moving.
_comment_otherworld: Species with "form": false are a world's NATIVE creatures (Nocthollow's, art by tools/gen_nocthollow.py): they wander as ambient pals but are never in the pool the companion's daemon form or the first-meeting flock shift between. "glows" is a per-variant soft light PalView haloes the creature with; "animate_idle": true keeps its motion cycle running while it hovers (floaters drift, they never stand still); "lore" is what Examining one reads; "temperament" is how it reacts to someone walking up: "shy" (it shrinks back) or "friendly" (it bobs happily).

lumejelly.lore: A lumejelly drifts past at eye height, slow as a held breath. Its tendrils brush the air and leave a faint shimmer behind.

glimmerhop.lore: A glimmerhop blinks up at you with enormous eyes. The little lamp on its antenna brightens, then bobs as if saying hello.

stiltwhisk.lore: A stiltwhisk lowers its long neck to look at you properly. The lights along its back ripple, one after another, like a greeting.

driftray.lore: A driftray circles overhead, its wings rippling like cloth in water. Its glowing tail draws a line across the dark.

lanternsnail.lore: A lanternsnail glides along on a ribbon of shimmer. Inside its crystal shell, something glows warm and slow, like a heartbeat.
